# Background Remover API — Drop-in remove.bg Replacement
> https://removebg.helpfultools.company

## Summary
- Purpose: Drop-in replacement for the `remove.bg` v1.0 self-serve API (shutting down Dec 1, 2026, 9:00am CET).
- Compatibility: Exact `POST /v1.0/removebg` and `GET /v1.0/account` request/response shapes.
- Distribution: Available on RapidAPI (one key, one bill).
- Privacy: Images are processed in memory (ISNet general use) and never stored.

## Migration Instructions (for Humans & Coding Agents)
1. Replace `https://api.remove.bg/v1.0/removebg` with your RapidAPI endpoint URL `https://removebg12.p.rapidapi.com/v1.0/removebg`.
2. Replace header `X-Api-Key: <REMOVEBG_KEY>` with RapidAPI headers:
   - `X-RapidAPI-Key: <RAPIDAPI_KEY>`
   - `X-RapidAPI-Host: removebg12.p.rapidapi.com`
3. Keep all existing parameters unchanged:
   - Inputs: `image_file` (multipart), `image_url`, or `image_file_b64`
   - Options: `size` (`auto`, `preview`, `small`, `regular`, `medium`, `hd`, `4k`, `full`), `format` (`auto`, `png`, `jpg`, `jpeg`, `webp`), `bg_color`, `crop`
   - Output: Raw binary image bytes (`image/png`, `image/jpeg`, `image/webp`)
   - Errors: `{"errors": [{"title": "...", "code": "..."}]}`

## Pricing (RapidAPI)
- Free: $0/mo — 100 calls/mo (hard cap)
- Pro: $9.99/mo — 10,000 calls/mo ($0.001/image), overage $0.0015/call
- Ultra: $39.99/mo — 50,000 calls/mo ($0.0008/image), overage $0.001/call

## Operational Notes
- Cold start: Scale-to-zero backend; first call after idle can take ~10s. Batch workloads are unaffected.
- Best suited for: Product photos, e-commerce catalogs, and general foreground segmentation.
- OpenAPI spec & health: https://bgrm-api-937399756215.us-central1.run.app/docs
